design: Exploratory reanalysis of previously exposed development maps. A shared nonlinear utility scores each full own command at its public root. Only the difference of the two scores contributes to loss.
primary_population: All 108 reconciled v1 original-Master3s2 terminal interventions, fixed previous 14 train / 4 held terrain split, both seats grouped. Additional streams from the same intervention diagnose reliability only.
secondary_population: Scan every live_protocol.json under reports/sapling_1200k. Tabulate package, source stage and follow-up overrides. Evaluate the largest later common suffix package 543a9d92 separately, single-change eligible roots only. No pooling across policies.
supervision: own normal team deposits less enemy normal team deposits through min(root+24, terminal)
same normal deposit margin through terminal
decision: Standardize each target by the training-only board-balanced root-mean-square size. Predict all three. Select the highest average predicted advantage across the three scaled outcomes only when all three exceed their incumbent's predictions, otherwise keep parent. Deterministic tie to parent. Same for real full-menu ranking and signed two-action diagnostics.
features: Only the acting seat's visible state and a complete contemporaneous own command. Economic destination, proposed moves, role, cargo, occupying teammates and public enemy reach. No seed, source family, observed enemy order, subsequent actions, repayment or terminal information.
training: Fixed four-hidden-unit tanh network, 220 full-batch gradient updates, Adam lr 0.012, ridge 0.025, fixed initial seed 62471. Per-board weights total equally. Targets winsorized at 2 training RMS for fitting only. No hyperparameter search. Shuffled-label baseline permutes paired outcome triplets within source sampler and role. Matched baseline estimates the mean labeled advantage on training boards within sampler and role, fallback to role then zero. Report both base action and always-alternative.
checks: Report true unrestricted-menu coverage, board means with board bootstrap, role and sampler slices, sign agreement of paired repeats, primary-vs-matched performance, new continuation/sampler transfer. Only archived choices have measured outcomes. A global candidate requires positive held signed gains on both terminal channels above matched control, support on both worker roles, and greater than half held unrestricted menu choices measured. No further optimization on these outcomes.
